sam_pr: Heads-up  Priya from DataSignals sent a last-minute redline: move embargo to 2026-05-03 11:00 PT and remove the comparative cost line. Need quick align.

maria_product: can we swap the quote to neutral language? suggest: "Redwood Inference provides predictable, low-latency LLM serving across hosted and private deployments."

jordan_legal: good but drop any implied guarantees. Edited line: "Redwood Inference helps teams run production LLMs with predictable performance and strong operational controls." Approved by legal.

olivia_ops: If embargo shifts to 11:00 PT ops will publish the press kit and trigger CDN purge at that time. Need final copy in the next 30m.

pressbot: [auto] Calendar updated: Analyst briefing proposed new time 2026-05-03 11:30 PT.

sam_pr: I'll send the updated briefing note + approved quote to Priya and the analyst list now and confirm the publish window. Posting update when sent.

maria_product: quick ask from Priya: include a short FAQ on on-prem and data isolation. Drafted in briefing doc and linked.

jordan_legal: minor tweak to FAQ language to avoid implying defaults; updated in doc.

sam_pr: Sent to Priya and group. Will monitor replies. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
